snippet.title: Mything gameplay
snippet.description:
We created this game for the Connexions 2025 game jam.

You can download it on itch.io: https://cularo-games.itch.io/mything

Gather your monsters and fight against the Gods of Greek mythology in this idle battler. Collect and upgrade your units.

The team :
Cassariel (https://cassariel.itch.io) - Localization, QA
ChooChooRayk (https://choochoorayk.itch.io) - Programming, VFX
Mesh Manticore (https://linktr.ee/Mesh_Manticore) - Character and environment art
Rod Zilla (https://rodzilla.itch.io) - Programming, VFX
Sisimonis (https://sisimonis.itch.io/) - Programming
Tilca (https://tilcamusic.com/) - Music & sound design
